matchups.tips: Amumu poses a moderate threat in 1v1 situations due to his crowd control and sustained damage from his tantrum. However, he lacks significant burst damage compared to other junglers. Applied Strategies: Invade his jungle early to set him behind and deny him farm. Dodge his Bandage Toss to avoid getting caught out of position. Counter-gank to punish his attempts at initiating fights. Maintain vision control to track his movements and prevent surprise engagements. Engage in skirmishes when his ultimate, Curse of the Sad Mummy, is on cooldown to exploit his vulnerability.
matchups.tipsFr: Amumu est une menace modérée en 1v1 grâce à son CC et aux dégâts continus de sa Colère (E). Par contre, il manque de burst par rapport aux autres junglers. Stratégies à appliquer : invade sa jungle en early pour le mettre en retard et lui refuser du farm. Esquive son bandage (A) pour ne pas te faire catch hors position. Contre-gank pour punir ses tentatives d'engage. Garde le contrôle de la vision pour suivre ses déplacements et éviter les engages surprises. Lance les escarmouches quand son ult, Malédiction d'Amumu (R), est en CD pour exploiter sa vulnérabilité.

matchups.tips: Ekko's mobility and burst damage make him a formidable opponent in 1v1 situations. His ability to rewind time with his ultimate, combined with crowd control from his W, can turn fights in his favor. Applied Strategies: Predict his movement to dodge his skill shots. Engage when his crowd control abilities are on cooldown. Control vision to limit his roaming potential. Counter-gank to punish his aggressive plays. Focus on securing objectives to maintain map control.
matchups.tipsFr: La mobilité et le burst d'Ekko en font un adversaire redoutable en 1v1. Sa capacité à remonter le temps avec son ult (R), combinée au CC de son Z, peut retourner les fights en sa faveur. Stratégies à appliquer : anticipe ses déplacements pour esquiver ses skillshots. Engage quand ses sorts de CC sont en CD. Contrôle la vision pour limiter son potentiel de roam. Contre-gank pour punir ses plays agressifs. Concentre-toi sur les objectifs pour garder le contrôle de la map.

matchups.tips: Elise excels in early duels with her high burst damage and crowd control from her Cocoon ability. She can quickly burst down squishy targets and outmaneuver opponents with her mobility. Applied Strategies: Avoid getting caught by her Cocoon ability by juking and using mobility spells. Counter-gank to turn the tide of fights in your favor, as Elise's early-game strength relies heavily on successful ganks. Ward her jungle entrances to track her movements and anticipate her gank paths. Engage in extended fights where her burst damage is less effective, especially if she misses her Cocoon. Utilize vision control to deny her vision and limit her map presence.
matchups.tipsFr: Elise excelle dans les duels en early grâce à son gros burst et au CC de son cocon (E). Elle peut burst rapidement les cibles squishy et prendre le dessus sur ses adversaires grâce à sa mobilité. Stratégies à appliquer : évite de te faire toucher par son cocon en jukant et en utilisant tes sorts de mobilité. Contre-gank pour retourner les fights en ta faveur, car la force d'Elise en early repose énormément sur des ganks réussis. Ward les entrées de sa jungle pour suivre ses déplacements et anticiper ses chemins de gank. Prends des fights longs, où son burst est moins efficace, surtout si elle rate son cocon. Utilise le contrôle de la vision pour lui refuser la vision et limiter sa présence sur la map.

matchups.tips: Evelynn's strength lies in her ability to catch opponents off guard with her stealth and burst damage. In 1v1 situations, she can quickly burst down targets with her Hate Spike ability and Allure charm. Applied Strategies: Invest in vision control to track Evelynn's movements and anticipate her gank paths, as she relies heavily on stealth for her engages. Avoid face-checking bushes or isolated areas where Evelynn may be lurking. Engage in team fights where Evelynn's squishiness and lack of crowd control make her vulnerable. Build magic resistance to mitigate Evelynn's burst damage, as she primarily deals magic damage. Coordinate with your team to collapse on Evelynn when she engages or attempts to flank during team fights.
matchups.tipsFr: La force d'Evelynn, c'est sa capacité à surprendre ses adversaires grâce à son camouflage et à son burst. En 1v1, elle peut burst rapidement ses cibles avec ses Piques de haine (A) et le charme de sa Séduction (Z). Stratégies à appliquer : investis dans la vision pour suivre les déplacements d'Evelynn et anticiper ses chemins de gank, car elle dépend énormément de son camouflage pour engage. Évite de facecheck les brushs ou les zones isolées où Evelynn peut se cacher. Prends les teamfights, où sa fragilité et son manque de CC la rendent vulnérable. Build de la résistance magique pour réduire son burst, car elle inflige surtout des dégâts magiques. Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour collapse sur Evelynn quand elle engage ou tente de flank pendant les teamfights.

matchups.tips: Fiddlesticks excels in extended fights due to his sustain from Drain and crowd control from Fear. Engaging him in a 1v1 situation can be challenging due to his ability to fear and silence opponents while draining their health. Applied Strategies: Avoid prolonged engagements with Fiddlesticks, as his sustain from Drain can outlast many opponents. Interrupt Fiddlesticks' Drain channel with crowd control abilities or by moving out of range. Prioritize vision control to prevent Fiddlesticks from ambushing with his Crowstorm ultimate. Coordinate with your team to focus Fiddlesticks in team fights, as he is susceptible to burst damage when caught out of position. Build magic resistance to mitigate Fiddlesticks' damage output, as he primarily deals magic damage.
matchups.tipsFr: Fiddlesticks excelle dans les fights longs grâce au sustain de son drain (Z) et au CC de son fear (A). L'affronter en 1v1 peut être compliqué, car il peut fear et silence ses adversaires tout en drainant leurs PV. Stratégies à appliquer : évite les fights prolongés contre Fiddlesticks, car le sustain de son drain lui permet de survivre à beaucoup d'adversaires. Coupe la canalisation de son drain avec du CC ou en sortant de sa range. Priorise le contrôle de la vision pour empêcher Fiddlesticks de t'embusquer avec son ult, Rafale de corbeaux (R). Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour focus Fiddlesticks en teamfight, car il est vulnérable au burst quand il se fait catch hors position. Build de la résistance magique pour réduire ses dégâts, car il inflige surtout des dégâts magiques.

matchups.tips: Gragas poses a moderate threat in 1v1 situations due to his ability to displace opponents with Body Slam and deal significant burst damage with his explosive barrels. His crowd control abilities also make him challenging to deal with in close combat. Applied Strategies: Avoid fighting Gragas in narrow spaces where his explosive barrels can easily hit multiple targets. Watch out for Gragas' Body Slam, which can be used to engage or disengage from fights. Try to anticipate its usage and position accordingly. Be mindful of Gragas' ultimate ability, Explosive Cask, which can disrupt your positioning and scatter your team in team fights. Position yourself away from walls to minimize its impact. Take advantage of Gragas' relatively long cooldowns early in the game. Look for opportunities to engage when his abilities are on cooldown. Consider building health and magic resistance items to withstand Gragas' burst damage and sustain longer in fights.
matchups.tipsFr: Gragas est une menace modérée en 1v1, car il peut déplacer ses adversaires avec son Coup de bidon (E) et faire un gros burst avec ses tonneaux explosifs (A). Son CC le rend aussi difficile à gérer au corps à corps. Stratégies à appliquer : évite d'affronter Gragas dans les passages étroits, où ses tonneaux peuvent facilement toucher plusieurs cibles. Méfie-toi de son Coup de bidon, qu'il peut utiliser pour engage ou pour disengage. Essaie d'anticiper quand il va l'utiliser et place-toi en conséquence. Fais attention à son ult, Fût explosif (R), qui peut casser ton placement et disperser ton équipe en teamfight. Reste loin des murs pour limiter son impact. Profite des CD assez longs de Gragas en début de game. Cherche à engage quand ses sorts sont en CD. Pense à build des items de PV et de résistance magique pour encaisser son burst et tenir plus longtemps dans les fights.

matchups.tips: Graves is a formidable duelist with high burst damage and sustained damage output, especially in close-range skirmishes. His Quickdraw ability allows him to kite opponents effectively while dealing significant damage with his shotgun shells. Additionally, Graves can quickly stack his True Grit passive, granting him bonus armor and magic resist in extended fights. Applied Strategies: Be cautious when engaging Graves in 1v1 situations, especially in close quarters where he can maximize the damage from his shotgun shells. Respect Graves' burst potential, particularly when he has accumulated multiple stacks of his True Grit passive. Look for opportunities to disengage if you are at risk of being overwhelmed. Utilize crowd control effects to disrupt Graves' movement and prevent him from freely kiting or repositioning during fights. Consider invading Graves early in the game to disrupt his jungle pathing and deny him resources. Coordinate with your team to secure vision and track his movements to set up successful counter-ganks. Build items that provide both offensive and defensive stats to withstand Graves' damage while also enhancing your own combat capabilities.
matchups.tipsFr: Graves est un duelliste redoutable, avec un gros burst et des dégâts soutenus, surtout dans les escarmouches à courte portée. Sa Ruée vers l'or (E) lui permet de kite efficacement tout en faisant de gros dégâts avec ses cartouches de fusil. En plus, Graves peut stack rapidement son passif True Grit, qui lui donne de l'armure et de la résistance magique bonus dans les fights longs. Stratégies à appliquer : sois prudent quand tu engages Graves en 1v1, surtout dans les espaces serrés où il maximise les dégâts de ses cartouches. Respecte son potentiel de burst, surtout quand il a accumulé plusieurs stacks de True Grit. Cherche à disengage si tu risques de te faire submerger. Utilise ton CC pour gêner les déplacements de Graves et l'empêcher de kite ou de se repositionner librement pendant les fights. Pense à invade Graves en early pour casser son pathing et lui refuser des ressources. Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour sécuriser la vision et suivre ses déplacements afin de préparer des contre-ganks réussis. Build des items qui donnent des stats offensives et défensives pour encaisser les dégâts de Graves tout en renforçant ta propre puissance en combat.

matchups.tips: Hecarim excels in prolonged engagements due to his sustained damage output and mobility from Devastating Charge and Onslaught of Shadows. His ability to close gaps quickly makes him a threatening duelist, especially in the mid to late game when he has accrued items and levels. Applied Strategies: Respect Hecarim's early game power spikes, particularly around level 3 and level 6 when he unlocks his full combo potential. Avoid engaging in extended duels during these phases unless you have a clear advantage. Utilize crowd control effects to disrupt Hecarim's engages and prevent him from reaching priority targets in teamfights. Abilities that can interrupt his Devastating Charge or Onslaught of Shadows can significantly hinder his effectiveness. Maintain vision control around objectives to track Hecarim's movements and anticipate potential gank paths. Warding river entrances and key jungle choke points can help mitigate the impact of his surprise engagements. Coordinate with your team to focus Hecarim during teamfights, especially if he builds full damage or has a significant lead. Prioritize shutting him down early to prevent him from snowballing and becoming an unstoppable force in the later stages of the game. Consider building items that offer a balance of damage and survivability to withstand Hecarim's burst while also contributing to your team's overall strength. Items with crowd control effects or movement speed bonuses can be particularly effective against him.
matchups.tipsFr: Hecarim excelle dans les fights prolongés grâce à ses dégâts soutenus et à la mobilité de sa Charge dévastatrice (E) et de sa Légion des ombres (R). Sa capacité à réduire la distance rapidement en fait un duelliste dangereux, surtout en mid et late game, quand il a accumulé items et niveaux. Stratégies à appliquer : respecte les power spikes d'Hecarim en early, surtout autour du niveau 3 et du niveau 6, quand il débloque tout son combo. Évite les duels longs pendant ces phases, sauf si tu as un net avantage. Utilise ton CC pour casser les engages d'Hecarim et l'empêcher d'atteindre les cibles prioritaires en teamfight. Les sorts qui peuvent interrompre sa Charge dévastatrice ou sa Légion des ombres réduisent énormément son efficacité. Garde le contrôle de la vision autour des objectifs pour suivre ses déplacements et anticiper ses chemins de gank. Ward les entrées de la rivière et les points de passage clés de la jungle : ça aide à limiter l'impact de ses engages surprises. Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour focus Hecarim en teamfight, surtout s'il build full dégâts ou s'il a une grosse avance. Priorise le fait de le shutdown tôt pour l'empêcher de snowball et de devenir inarrêtable plus tard dans la game. Pense à build des items qui équilibrent dégâts et survie pour encaisser le burst d'Hecarim tout en contribuant à la force de ton équipe. Les items avec du CC ou des bonus de vitesse de déplacement peuvent être particulièrement efficaces contre lui.

matchups.tips: Ivern is not known for his dueling prowess. His strength lies in his ability to support his team through utility and objective control rather than winning skirmishes. However, he can still pose a threat if underestimated, especially when he has assistance from his allies. Applied Strategies: Capitalize on Ivern's weak early game dueling by invading his jungle and contesting his camps. Force him to retreat or call for backup from his teammates, potentially opening opportunities for your team to secure objectives elsewhere on the map. Keep track of Ivern's position on the map through warding and communication with your team. His tendency to prioritize supporting lanes and objectives means he may be vulnerable to counter-jungling or ganks from aggressive junglers. Exploit Ivern's lack of mobility and crowd control in teamfights by targeting him when he's out of position or isolated from his team. Focus on bursting him down quickly before he can utilize his utility spells to turn the tide of the fight. Prioritize denying Ivern access to key objectives such as Dragon and Baron by maintaining vision control and contesting vision around these areas. Preventing him from securing these objectives can significantly hinder his team's overall game plan. Consider building items with Grievous Wounds to mitigate Ivern's healing from Triggerseed and Moonstone Renewer. This can help reduce his effectiveness as a supportive champion and make it easier to take him down in teamfights.
matchups.tipsFr: Ivern n'est pas réputé pour ses talents de duelliste. Sa force, c'est sa capacité à soutenir son équipe avec de l'utilité et le contrôle des objectifs, plutôt que de gagner les escarmouches. Par contre, il peut quand même être dangereux si tu le sous-estimes, surtout quand ses alliés l'aident. Stratégies à appliquer : profite de la faiblesse d'Ivern en duel en early en invadant sa jungle et en contestant ses camps. Force-le à reculer ou à appeler ses coéquipiers à l'aide, ce qui peut ouvrir des opportunités à ton équipe pour sécuriser des objectifs ailleurs sur la map. Suis la position d'Ivern sur la map grâce aux wards et à la communication avec ton équipe. Comme il a tendance à prioriser le soutien des lanes et les objectifs, il peut être vulnérable au counter-jungle ou aux ganks des junglers agressifs. Exploite son manque de mobilité et de CC en teamfight en le ciblant quand il est hors position ou isolé de son équipe. Concentre-toi sur le fait de le burst rapidement avant qu'il puisse utiliser ses sorts utilitaires pour retourner le fight. Priorise le fait de refuser à Ivern l'accès aux objectifs clés comme le Drake et le Nashor en gardant le contrôle de la vision et en contestant la vision autour de ces zones. L'empêcher de sécuriser ces objectifs peut fortement gêner le plan de jeu de son équipe. Pense à build des items avec Blessures graves pour réduire les soins d'Ivern venant de sa Graine à retardement (E) et du Régénérateur de pierre de lune. Ça peut réduire son efficacité en tant que champion de soutien et le rendre plus facile à tuer en teamfight.

matchups.tips: Jarvan IV is a strong duelist, especially in the early to mid-game stages. His passive, Dragon Strike, combined with his abilities' crowd control effects and burst damage potential, make him a threat in 1v1 situations. Additionally, his Cataclysm ultimate can isolate and trap opponents, further amplifying his dueling capabilities. Applied Strategies: Be cautious when engaging Jarvan IV in 1v1 situations, especially in the early game when he has high burst damage potential. Consider the strength of your champion relative to Jarvan IV's and avoid fighting him head-on unless you have a clear advantage. Utilize mobility and crowd control abilities to outmaneuver Jarvan IV and create opportunities to disengage or turn the fight in your favor. Champions with dashes, blinks, or crowd control effects can effectively disrupt Jarvan IV's combos and escape his Cataclysm trap. Punish Jarvan IV for overextending or committing too aggressively to fights. His all-in playstyle can leave him vulnerable to counterattacks if he misuses his abilities or engages without proper vision and backup from his team. Coordinate with your team to counter Jarvan IV's engages and rotations. Communication and map awareness are crucial for predicting his movements and responding accordingly, whether it's collapsing on him during a gank or contesting objectives he's attempting to secure. Build defensively against Jarvan IV's burst damage and crowd control effects. Items that provide health, armor, or crowd control reduction can help mitigate his impact in skirmishes and teamfights, making it easier to survive his engages and turn the tide of battle in your favor.
matchups.tipsFr: Jarvan IV est un bon duelliste, surtout en early et en mid game. Sa Frappe du dragon (A), combinée au CC et au potentiel de burst de ses sorts, fait de lui une menace en 1v1. En plus, son ult, Cataclysme (R), peut isoler et piéger ses adversaires, ce qui renforce encore son potentiel en duel. Stratégies à appliquer : sois prudent quand tu engages Jarvan IV en 1v1, surtout en early, quand son potentiel de burst est élevé. Compare la force de ton champion à celle de Jarvan IV et évite de l'affronter de face, sauf si tu as un net avantage. Utilise tes sorts de mobilité et de CC pour prendre le dessus sur Jarvan IV et te créer des occasions de disengage ou de retourner le fight en ta faveur. Les champions avec des dashs, des blinks ou du CC peuvent casser efficacement ses combos et s'échapper de son Cataclysme. Punis Jarvan IV quand il overextend ou qu'il s'engage trop agressivement dans les fights. Son style all-in peut le rendre vulnérable aux contre-attaques s'il gâche ses sorts ou engage sans vision ni soutien de son équipe. Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour contrer les engages et les rotations de Jarvan IV. La communication et la lecture de la map sont essentielles pour prévoir ses déplacements et réagir en conséquence, que ce soit pour collapse sur lui pendant un gank ou pour contester les objectifs qu'il essaie de sécuriser. Build défensif contre le burst et le CC de Jarvan IV. Les items qui donnent des PV, de l'armure ou de la réduction de CC peuvent limiter son impact en escarmouche et en teamfight, ce qui te permet de survivre plus facilement à ses engages et de retourner le combat en ta faveur.

matchups.tips: Jax is a formidable duelist throughout the game, with the potential to outscale many opponents. His kit, especially his Counter Strike (E), allows him to mitigate incoming damage and stun opponents, making him challenging to duel in extended fights. Additionally, his passive, Relentless Assault, grants him bonus attack speed with each consecutive attack, further enhancing his dueling power. Applied Strategies: Respect Jax's early-game strength, especially if he has Conqueror/Lethal Tempo fully stacked or his Counter Strike available. Avoid extended trades unless you have a significant advantage, as Jax excels in prolonged engagements where he can stack his passive and Conqueror to maximize damage output. Utilize crowd control effects and kiting to disrupt Jax's combo and prevent him from landing consecutive basic attacks. Champions with slows, stuns, or displacement abilities can effectively neutralize Jax's mobility and trading potential, giving you an edge in duels. Exploit Jax's weaknesses in the early levels and punish him for overextending or committing too aggressively to trades. Coordinate with your jungler to set up ganks and deny Jax the opportunity to snowball, as falling behind can significantly impact his scaling potential. Be mindful of Jax's potential to split push and take objectives quickly, especially as he scales into the mid and late game. Maintain vision control around key objectives and be prepared to respond to Jax's split push attempts with appropriate map rotations and team coordination. Consider building items that provide both offensive and defensive stats to match Jax's versatile playstyle. Items with health, armor, and crowd control reduction can help mitigate his burst damage and crowd control effects, while also enhancing your own dueling capabilities.
matchups.tipsFr: Jax est un duelliste redoutable pendant toute la game, capable d'outscale beaucoup d'adversaires. Son kit, surtout sa Contre-attaque (E), lui permet de réduire les dégâts subis et de stun ses adversaires, ce qui le rend difficile à affronter dans les fights longs. En plus, son passif, Acharnement, lui donne de la vitesse d'attaque bonus à chaque attaque consécutive, ce qui renforce encore sa puissance en duel. Stratégies à appliquer : respecte la force de Jax en early, surtout s'il a Conquérant/Tempo mortel full stack ou sa Contre-attaque disponible. Évite les trades longs sauf si tu as un gros avantage, car Jax excelle dans les fights prolongés où il peut stack son passif et Conquérant pour maximiser ses dégâts. Utilise ton CC et le kite pour casser le combo de Jax et l'empêcher d'enchaîner les auto-attaques. Les champions avec des slows, des stuns ou des déplacements forcés peuvent neutraliser sa mobilité et son potentiel de trade, ce qui te donne l'avantage en duel. Coordonne-toi avec ton jungler pour préparer des ganks et empêcher Jax de snowball, car prendre du retard peut fortement impacter son scaling. Méfie-toi de son potentiel de split push et de sa capacité à prendre les objectifs rapidement, surtout quand il scale en mid et late game. Garde le contrôle de la vision autour des objectifs clés et sois prêt à répondre à ses split push avec les bonnes rotations et une bonne coordination d'équipe. Pense à build des items qui donnent des stats offensives et défensives pour suivre le style polyvalent de Jax. Les items avec des PV, de l'armure et de la réduction de CC peuvent limiter son burst et son CC, tout en renforçant ta propre puissance en duel.

matchups.tips: Karthus is not known for his strong dueling potential, especially in the early stages of the game. While he can deal significant damage with his Lay Waste (Q) ability, his lack of mobility and reliance on skillshots make him vulnerable to champions with gap closers or crowd control. However, Karthus becomes increasingly dangerous as he scales into the late game, where his sustained damage output and global presence with his Requiem (R) ability can turn the tide of teamfights. Applied Strategies: Capitalize on Karthus's weak early game by applying pressure and contesting objectives aggressively. Champions with strong early ganking potential can exploit Karthus's immobility and lack of defensive tools to secure kills or force him out of lane, delaying his power spike and scaling into the late game. Coordinate with your team to deny Karthus vision and control over key areas of the map, especially around neutral objectives like Dragon and Baron Nashor. By limiting Karthus's ability to farm safely and scale, you can delay his impact on teamfights and reduce the effectiveness of his global ultimate. Prioritize building magic resistance items and health regeneration to mitigate Karthus's poke damage and sustain through his harassment in lane. Items like Mercury's Treads and Spirit Visage can help you survive Karthus's burst combo and sustain through extended trades, allowing you to outlast him in duels and skirmishes. Be mindful of Karthus's Requiem ability and its global impact on teamfights. Coordinate with your team to spread out and avoid clumping together when engaging in fights, minimizing the effectiveness of Karthus's ultimate and reducing its potential to secure kills or swing fights in his team's favor. Exploit Karthus's lack of mobility and vulnerability to crowd control effects in teamfights by focusing him down quickly or zoning him out of fights with hard engage or displacement abilities. Champions with gap closers or crowd control can isolate Karthus from his team and prevent him from dealing damage safely, giving your team a significant advantage in teamfights.

Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour vous écarter et éviter de vous regrouper quand vous engagez, afin de limiter l'efficacité de son ult et de réduire ses chances de prendre des kills ou de faire basculer les fights en faveur de son équipe. Exploite son manque de mobilité et sa vulnérabilité au CC en teamfight en le focus rapidement ou en le zonant hors des fights avec du hard engage ou des sorts de déplacement forcé. matchups.tips: Kayn's dueling potential can vary depending on his form. As Shadow Assassin, he excels at bursting down squishy targets with his high mobility and damage output. Rhaast, on the other hand, is more durable and sustained in fights, making him a formidable duelist against bruisers and tanks. In the early game, Kayn can be vulnerable before transforming, especially against champions with strong early skirmishing or invade potential. However, once he evolves, Kayn becomes a significant threat in 1v1 situations, especially if he has item advantage or has secured takedowns to empower his form. Applied Strategies: Track Kayn's transformation progress and adjust your playstyle accordingly. If he's close to evolving into Shadow Assassin, prioritize denying him takedowns and contesting his jungle camps to delay his transformation and delay his power spike. Conversely, if he's leaning towards Rhaast, be cautious about engaging in prolonged duels with him, as he excels in sustained fights and can outlast you with his healing and crowd control. Ward key areas of the map to track Kayn's movement and prevent him from snowballing through successful ganks or invades. Vision control is crucial in spotting Kayn's rotations and predicting his pathing, allowing you to counter his plays and protect vulnerable lanes from his pressure. Coordinate with your team to collapse on Kayn when he attempts to invade or contest objectives. Kayn's mobility can make him slippery to catch, but with proper crowd control and focus fire, you can punish him for overextending or committing to risky plays in your jungle. Build defensively against Kayn's primary damage type and form. Against Shadow Assassin, prioritize armor and health items to mitigate his burst damage and survive his assassination attempts. Against Rhaast, invest in magic resistance and health regeneration to withstand his sustained damage output and outlast him in prolonged fights. Exploit Kayn's weaknesses in the early game and deny him resources to delay his transformation. Invade his jungle, contest scuttle crabs, and pressure his lanes to limit his options and set him behind. By denying Kayn's transformation and delaying his power spike, you can significantly reduce his impact on the game and gain an advantage over him in the mid to late game.
matchups.tipsFr: Le potentiel de Kayn en duel varie selon sa forme. En Assassin de l'ombre, il excelle à burst les cibles squishy grâce à sa grosse mobilité et à ses dégâts. Rhaast, de son côté, est plus résistant et tient mieux dans les fights, ce qui en fait un duelliste redoutable contre les bruisers et les tanks. Par contre, une fois transformé, Kayn devient une vraie menace en 1v1, surtout s'il a un avantage d'items ou s'il a pris des kills pour renforcer sa forme. Stratégies à appliquer : suis la progression de la transformation de Kayn et adapte ton style de jeu en conséquence. S'il est proche de passer en Assassin de l'ombre, priorise le fait de lui refuser des kills et de contester ses camps pour retarder sa transformation et son power spike. À l'inverse, s'il part sur Rhaast, méfie-toi des duels prolongés avec lui, car il excelle dans les fights longs et peut te survivre grâce à ses soins et à son CC. Ward les zones clés de la map pour suivre les déplacements de Kayn et l'empêcher de snowball avec des ganks ou des invades réussis. Le contrôle de la vision est crucial pour repérer ses rotations et prévoir son pathing, ce qui te permet de contrer ses plays et de protéger les lanes vulnérables de sa pression. Coordonne-toi avec ton équipe pour collapse sur Kayn quand il tente d'invade ou de contester des objectifs. Sa mobilité peut le rendre insaisissable, mais avec un bon CC et du focus, tu peux le punir quand il overextend ou tente des plays risqués dans ta jungle. Build défensif selon le type de dégâts principal et la forme de Kayn. Contre l'Assassin de l'ombre, priorise les items d'armure et de PV pour limiter son burst et survivre à ses tentatives d'assassinat. Contre Rhaast, investis dans la résistance magique et la régénération de PV pour encaisser ses dégâts soutenus et lui survivre dans les fights prolongés. Exploite les faiblesses de Kayn en early et refuse-lui des ressources pour retarder sa transformation. Invade sa jungle, conteste les scuttles et mets la pression sur ses lanes pour limiter ses options et le mettre en retard. Applied Strategies: Avoid isolated areas when facing Kha'Zix, as he excels at picking off isolated targets with his bonus damage from Unseen Threat. Stick close to your teammates and avoid straying too far from safety, especially when moving through unwarded areas of the map. Coordinate with your team to deny Kha'Zix isolated targets by grouping up during skirmishes and team fights. By staying close together, you can minimize the effectiveness of Kha'Zix's isolation mechanic and force him to engage in less favorable conditions. Prioritize vision control to track Kha'Zix's movements and prevent him from ambushing unsuspecting targets. Ward key areas of the map, such as jungle entrances and river objectives, to spot Kha'Zix's rotations and anticipate his gank paths. Build defensively against Kha'Zix's burst damage and adapt your itemization based on his evolving abilities. Consider investing in armor or health items to mitigate his physical damage output, or prioritize magic resistance if Kha'Zix evolves his Void Spike ability for increased magic damage. Punish Kha'Zix for overextending or committing to risky plays by coordinating with your team to collapse on him during skirmishes or objective contests. Use crowd control and focus fire to lock him down and burst him before he can escape or turn the fight in his favor. Be mindful of Kha'Zix's stealth capabilities and use Sweeping Lens or Control Wards to reveal his location and deny him the element of surprise. By maintaining vision control and denying Kha'Zix opportunities to flank or ambush your team, you can mitigate his impact and secure objectives more safely.

Applied Strategies: Engage Kindred when her abilities are on cooldown, particularly her Dance of Arrows and Lamb's Respite. Punish Kindred for overextending or committing to risky plays by collapsing on her with your team during skirmishes or objective contests. Ward key areas of the map, particularly river entrances and jungle camps, to gather information on his movements and coordinate with your team to counter his ganks. Prioritize vision control to deny Lee Sin opportunities to make impactful plays and snowball the game. Place wards in his jungle to track his movements and set up counter-ganks, while also securing vision around objectives to prevent him from securing objectives uncontested. Build defensively against Lee Sin's burst damage and crowd control, prioritizing items that offer health, armor, or magic resistance. Additionally, invest in mobility-enhancing items like Boots of Swiftness or Mercury's Treads to mitigate the impact of his crowd control abilities and improve your kiting potential. Coordinate with your team to punish Lee Sin's weaknesses in team fights by focusing him down or isolating him from his team.
